mobile.time.bucket.today.note: Notifications inbox section heading and Team Bridge thread day divider for items from this local calendar day. Short heading, keep under ~16 characters. Sentence case. No placeholders.

mobile.time.bucket.yesterday.note: Notifications inbox section heading and Team Bridge thread day divider for items from the previous local calendar day. Short heading, keep under ~16 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.time.bucket.earlier_this_week.note: Notifications inbox section heading for items from two to six days ago (before yesterday, within the last week). Short heading, keep under ~24 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.time.bucket.earlier.note: Notifications inbox section heading for items older than a week. One short word, keep under ~16 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.time.relative.now.note: Timestamp for something under a minute old, shown alone in a narrow row meta slot (session drawer rows, Team Bridge list rows). One lower-case word; keep it as short as possible (~6 characters). No placeholders.

mobile.time.relative.just_now.note: Relative age for something under a minute old. Appears alone or after a separator, e.g. 'Asleep · just now' on a computer row, 'Last update just now'. Lower case in English because it sits mid-line. Keep under ~12 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.time.relative.yesterday.note: Relative age for a notification that is one day old, in the inbox row's narrow meta line and its screen-reader label. Lower case in English because it sits mid-line. No placeholders.

mobile.time.relative.seconds_ago_compact.note: Compact relative age in seconds (5–59), e.g. '12s ago', in a stale-connection note. {count} is an integer; # renders it. 's' is an abbreviated unit: use your language's customary short form. Narrow slot, keep compact.

mobile.time.relative.minutes_ago.note: Relative age in whole minutes, e.g. '5 min ago' ('Asleep · 5 min ago' on a computer row, the Past list, a stale-connection note). {count} is an integer ≥ 1; # renders it. Keep the short unit; ~14 characters.

mobile.time.relative.hours_ago.note: Relative age in whole hours with a spaced abbreviated unit, e.g. '3 h ago', on computer rows and the Past list. {count} is an integer ≥ 1; # renders it. Keep the short unit; ~12 characters.

mobile.time.relative.days_ago.note: Relative age in whole days with a spaced abbreviated unit, e.g. '4 d ago', on computer rows and the Past list. {count} is an integer ≥ 1; # renders it. Keep the short unit; ~12 characters.

mobile.time.relative.minutes_ago_compact.note: Compact relative age in minutes, no space before the unit, e.g. '5m ago', in the notifications inbox row meta. {count} is an integer ≥ 1; # renders it. Narrow slot: keep the abbreviated unit, ~10 characters.

mobile.time.relative.hours_ago_compact.note: Compact relative age in hours, no space before the unit, e.g. '3h ago', in the notifications inbox row meta and a stale-connection note. {count} is an integer ≥ 1; # renders it. Narrow slot, ~10 characters.

mobile.time.relative.days_ago_compact.note: Compact relative age in days, no space before the unit, e.g. '4d ago', in the notifications inbox row meta and a stale-connection note. {count} is an integer ≥ 2 in the inbox (1 reads 'yesterday'); # renders it. Narrow slot, ~10 characters.

mobile.time.short.seconds.note: A bare duration in seconds, e.g. '45s': elapsed time on a transcript, a schedule's 'in 45s', a connection's '12s'. {count} is an integer; # renders it. Use your language's customary one- or two-letter unit abbreviation; this is a tight token, ~4 characters.

mobile.time.short.minutes.note: A bare duration in minutes, e.g. '5m': a schedule's 'in 5m', a connection's age, a Team Bridge row stamp. {count} is an integer; # renders it. Customary short unit abbreviation; tight token, ~4 characters.

mobile.time.short.hours.note: A bare duration in hours, e.g. '3h': a schedule's due time, a connection's age, a session drawer row's time, a Team Bridge row stamp. {count} is an integer; # renders it. Customary short unit abbreviation; tight token, ~4 characters.

mobile.time.short.days.note: A bare duration in days, e.g. '2d': a schedule's due time, a session drawer row's time, a Team Bridge row stamp. {count} is an integer; # renders it. Customary short unit abbreviation; tight token, ~4 characters.

mobile.time.short.weeks.note: A bare age in weeks on a session drawer row, e.g. '3w'. {count} is an integer; # renders it. Customary short unit abbreviation; tight token, ~4 characters.

mobile.time.short.years.note: A bare age in years on a session drawer row, e.g. '2y'. {count} is an integer; # renders it. Customary short unit abbreviation; tight token, ~4 characters.

mobile.time.short.minutes_spaced.note: A bare age in minutes with a spaced unit on a session drawer row, e.g. '12 min' (the row's narrow time column). {count} is an integer ≥ 1; # renders it. Keep it ~7 characters.

mobile.time.short.minutes_seconds.note: An elapsed duration under an hour on a running transcript item, e.g. '4m 07s'. {minutes} is an integer; # renders it. {seconds} is ALWAYS two digits, zero-padded ('07'), so the width never jitters as it ticks; do not reformat it. Keep both unit abbreviations short and the order minutes then seconds.

mobile.time.short.hours_minutes.note: An elapsed duration of an hour or more on a running transcript item, e.g. '2h 07m'. {hours} is an integer; # renders it. {minutes} is ALWAYS two digits, zero-padded ('07'); do not reformat it. Keep both unit abbreviations short and the order hours then minutes.
